findings.title: Local path and alias limits are not specified
findings.detail: The design calls aliases and configured directories bounded and promises tests for every numeric limit, but gives no alias length/character set, path length, or concrete limits for several .git metadata values and directory/reference traversal. These are operator-controlled inputs that reach the helper and filesystem; without explicit values and rejection behavior, implementation and boundary tests cannot demonstrate a bounded input surface or reliably prove private-path handling.
findings.minimal_fix: Specify concrete maximum lengths/counts and accepted forms for aliases, absolute paths, .git metadata/ref files and any traversed refs/directories; reject invalid values at startup or as unknown at read time, and add at/over-limit tests for each.

findings.title: No-follow checks do not define race-safe local reads
findings.detail: The design rejects a symlink for the final .runner file and validates checkout Git metadata before reading committed objects, but does not require opening/reading those files through a handle that prevents replacement or re-resolution between validation and use. A writable runner/config directory could replace the checked file or metadata with a symlink during refresh, redirecting reads outside the selected source or changing the object/ref after validation. This matters because the proposal explicitly treats configured paths and source contents as private bounded inputs.
findings.minimal_fix: Define race-safe file access for .runner and checkout metadata (for example no-follow opens, regular-file checks and reads from the same opened handle, with bounded traversal beneath the configured root); otherwise document and enforce the required directory ownership/immutability assumption. Add replacement/symlink race tests.

dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.assessment: The owner first-slice criteria are represented by the separate local/GitHub/adoption views and specific observation/coverage behavior; future capacity and usage are expressly deferred.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.assessment: Tasks cover the requested first milestone and integration; no issue57 implementation is claimed. The unbounded input details in R57-1 remain to be resolved.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.assessment: Substantial source, authority, cancellation, concurrency, browser and real-observation evidence is planned, but R57-1/R57-2 need corresponding bounded-input and race cases.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.assessment: Full npm run verify and hosted CI are explicitly required at implementation Done.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.assessment: Source separation, least authority, tokenless fixed Git commands, no credential fallback and redaction are well specified; local input bounds/race safety remain actionable gaps.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.assessment: The proposal follows existing Workspace owner admission and connected-user GitHub authority seams and cites current ADRs; implementation must retain those boundaries.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.assessment: Implementation architecture, README and configuration documentation are included in task 4.2.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.assessment: Product citations and a scope-specific OpenSpec delta are present; accepted product remains authoritative and no product change is proposed.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.assessment: Real selected-host and committed-adoption evidence, CI and exact-head review are required. Operator gh cannot stand in for connected-user authority; unknown limitations remain explicit.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.assessment: Configured distinct LunaHigh final-head review and all protected human/forge gates are retained; no bypass is proposed.

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.assessment: The plan explicitly defers capacity/usage/health/reservations, marks unsupported organization-only registrations and telemetry unknown, and records phone rehearsal as owner-deferred.
